I'll leave the exterior details to you! The head is usually red and yellow odd eyes, but when it's ready to fight, it transforms into four eyes, and I want the odd eyes to be placed in opposite directions. Also, I want the mouth area to look like teeth when it's deformed! I don't have a weapon, I fight with my fists. I'd like to see some kind of gimmick on his arms, but I'll leave that up to you. I'm not sure if I should write my name down, but I'll write it down as Roy Armis. Again, thank you for your support!

性格はお茶目な大人のお姉さんというかメイド長。

体内に変化が起き本人の知らぬ間に生殖機能を獲得してる。
これによりというロボットから人という概念に該当することになる。
という感じです！
